prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain, stiffness, and headache, consistent with a whiplash-associated disorder. On initial examination, cervical range of motion was reduced in all planes, with tenderness over the paraspinal muscles and upper trapezius. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms reported.

Over the course of 16 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, graded cervical range-of-motion exercises, postural education, and a home exercise program. Pain levels decreased steadily from the initial assessment, and range of motion improved substantially by the midpoint of treatment. Headache frequency declined, and the patient reported improved sleep and ability to perform daily activities and work duties.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient had residual mild stiffness with intermittent discomfort during prolonged computer use, but reported overall marked improvement. Continued self-directed home exercise and ergonomic modifications were recommended. Discharge from active care is appropriate at this time, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
